headline: Iran Conditions Opening of Hormuz on a Ceasefire That Includes Lebanon and the Gaza Strip
summary: Iran is conditioning the opening of the Strait of Hormuz on a ceasefire that includes Lebanon and the Gaza Strip. The conditions were set by a former Revolutionary Guard commander now serving as the supreme leader's representative.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major oil transit route, so any restriction on it directly affects global crude supply.
why_moved: Iran conditioned reopening Hormuz on a ceasefire that includes Lebanon and Gaza, prolonging uncertainty over Gulf oil shipments.
